purpose: Decide whether an automated Pennsylvania vendor-intake workflow may continue or must pause for human review based on bounded public evidence.

decision_policy.human_review: Any failed, unavailable, uncertain, or contradictory required check.

claim_boundaries: proceed is not legal or compliance approval
a no-candidate OFAC result is not sanctions clearance
OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis is not included
registry matching is not proof of good standing, ownership, or authority
Census matching is not proof of control of an address
RDAP registration is not proof of domain ownership
